Node canvas coordinates ``{x, y}``.

Required on the v2 surface: the builder cannot render a node without a
position, and the server never invents one. Carried verbatim so a
read -> edit -> write cycle preserves layout. ``int | float`` keeps the
builder's integer coordinates integer (lossless round-trip).

GlobalNodeSetting.description:
Node-level global marker. Presence of this object == global node.

A global node is reachable from anywhere, so the public v2 graph carries no
entry edges for it — only this marker plus its enter ``condition``.

The enter condition is the ``ai`` variant only. A ``logic`` / ``fallback``
enter condition is rejected on write (``global_node_condition_unsupported``),
so the schema is narrowed to ``AiCondition`` to advertise exactly what is
accepted.

A single deterministic comparison inside a ``logic`` condition (Retell-aligned equations shape).

Retell-aligned naming: ``left`` is the extracted variable, ``right`` is the
compared value (omitted for ``exists`` / ``does_not_exist``).

expected_flow_revision.title: Expected Flow Revision
expected_flow_revision.description: Optional. The Flow `flow_revision` you last read; omit to save against the current Flow.

name.title: Name
name.description: New agent display name. Omit the field to keep the current name; `null` is rejected.

data.description: PATCH payload for agent configuration. Shape is published as `agent-schema/agent-data-update`. Omitted top-level sub-schemas are kept; sent sub-schemas are merged by the service according to the update schema.

flow.description: PATCH payload for the flow graph — use this instead of the deprecated `flow_data`. Replaces the whole graph; omit it to keep the current one. Sending `null` is rejected (it would be a misleading no-op); omit the field instead. If you send both `flow` and `flow_data`, `flow` is used and `flow_data` is ignored. The exact shape is published at the `flow-schema/flow-data` schema endpoint.

UpdateAgentRequest.title: UpdateAgentRequest
UpdateAgentRequest.description:
Agent patch request.

- Send at least one field.
- Omit fields to keep existing values.
- `type` is create-time only.
- Send `flow` to replace a flow agent's graph; `flow_data` is the deprecated
  builder-shape equivalent kept for compatibility.
